kit: Ansal Sushant City - warm dusty stylized material kit
style: Stylized hand-painted color maps, not photographic reconstructions. Subtle material relief and roughness are painted into albedo; no separate normal or roughness textures.
provenance: Procedurally painted by this task from the three supplied district visual-rules documents (Google Street View June 2023 observations); illustrative material motifs, not sampled/photographic Street View pixels.
important_limits: Based on supplied visual-rule prose from sampled June 2023 Street View. No source frames or actual photographic texture pixels were reproduced. Do not present textures as exact surveyed facade matches.
The dashed road marking is optional and should only be used where source panoramas confirm one; residential lanes generally have no lane stripes.
RepeatWrapping horizontally and vertically; no mip bleeding at tile boundaries. Generate mipmaps in Three.js, use SRGBColorSpace for albedo and anisotropy 4 if available.
District labels identify palette suitability, not location-accurate placement. Combine with geometry, vacancies, and verified landmark models.

Round 2 RGBA decals use transparency. Wall-bottom dust and rain streaks tile horizontally but must be applied only once vertically to preserve location below parapets/base; road-edge crumble must be used once across width, repeated along length.

The temple is visually documented as a white multi-shikhar building, but a white marble material has not been verified. The temple-stone texture is an illustrative option, not a claim about construction.
Most builder-floor homes are flat-roofed in the surveyed material. Tiled roof textures are selective accents, not the default roof.
